gunGrantSemantics.meaning: RewardValue is a zero-based Gun_manager.Gun_list index, not quantity, unlock-only flag, or degree. Runtime sourceGun(RewardValue) matches the extracted guns.json index and sourceID.
gunGrantSemantics.inventoryGrant: FindFirstEmptyOwned scans Owned_Gun_list for -1, writes RewardValue into that slot; no existing-same-gun test. Grant one additional inventory gun even if already owned.
gunGrantSemantics.inventoryFull: FindFirstEmptyOwned returns -1; Reward_Get_Value shows alert and returns false, so Reward_Grant does not mark reward claimed. Keep reward claimable and do not consume the claim.
gunGrantSemantics.collection: Gun_Collect flag is used only by NewGun_UI_Reload to suppress repeat discovery UI. It does not prevent duplicate inventory grants. OnWeaponAcquired increments acquisition count by gun degree.
evidence: Reward_Grant0x2aa6494: claim byte written only after consumer returns true
